comparison.objective: Align and cut card on a guillotine while keeping the free hand outside the blade hazard zone.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold material aligned while safely lowering a hinged cutter handle.
comparison.success_condition: Card aligned and flat during cut, blade left down, hands withdrawn; hazard-zone entry permanently fails.
comparison.reason: Tests guarded cutting and hand-path safety, with no fine tool insertion, setting adjustment, or iterative physical-response evaluation.
